dispute.claim_text: I realised we were going the wrong way when I saw the Kallang signs. He said some car flashed him from behind so he thought the road was closed. Since when does a road closure come from a car behind you? I didn't argue in the car because I thought the fare would be adjusted. It wasn't. I paid nearly three times the normal price for his mistake.

counterparty_statement.text: A car behind me flashed high beams several times near the exit. I thought there was an accident ahead so I stayed on the expressway. I turned back at the next exit. I didn't do it on purpose, it was a safety decision.
